notes.title: Discover Dark Fracture, a new kind of psychological horror adventure
notes.content:
Feardemic is proud to announce the next generation of terror: Dark Fracture, a psychological first-person horror adventure game in which jump scares are the least concerning occurrences that the players will be facing.

The game is developed by the indie team Twisted II Studio and will be released in 2022 on PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

About the game

Set in the late 90s in a forested area of the Northeastern USA, Dark Fracture brings you into the eerie environment of a body farm – a decomposition research facility. You enter the world as Edward, a lonely individual tormented by a tragic past, whose only solace is in the medicine that helps him to get through the day. Edward is barely able to cope with his issues, which are only intensified by the solitude of his workplace. He puts on a brave front and dutifully wakes up for work every day. His routine serves as his only anchor, but deep inside, trouble is simmering...

If you want to get a taste of what awaits you in Dark Fracture, you can already try Dark Fracture: Prologue, the free introductory chapter of the game 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389160/Dark_Fracture_Prologue/

notes.title: One Shell Straight to Hell release date reveal!
notes.content:
Dear Brothers and Sisters, your one and only Padre Alexander is coming back in One Shell Straight To Hell on February 9, 2021! 

That’s right, Padre Alexander is back, heavily armed to fight off hordes of demons while doing his best to help the Halliwell family. Join the fight in One Shell Straight To Hell, the isometric, dungeon-crawling roguelike shooter. 

One Shell Straight To Hell will descend you into ever-changing dungeons that overflow with demonic enemies and put your insane skills and over the top weapons to the test against the satanic hordes. To survive you must shout orders to your allies, lay your traps, and raise your gun to lay waste to your enemies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

 Key Features: 

Perplexing monsters- Ranging from the possessed kitchen drawer to drunken long-dead pirate captains and... I almost forgot, demons... a lot of demons.
Regular weapons using a variety of ammunition, holy weapons drawing on your faith, and unholy weapons craving for your blood.
Skill tree that makes you stronger and adds to the strategy.
Base building... at least kind of. You will be able to build small factories to prepare...
Traps for your enemies.
Global enchantments
Power-ups
Randomly generated ‘dungeon’ maps
And some more crazy absurd stuff!


Take a look at the newest trailer of One Shell Straight To Hell:  
[previewyoutube=PZkPm87qP6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DARQ: Complete Edition is HERE!
notes.content:
Our friendly dev team Unfold Games has just released their award-winning game DARQ with a little extra on top. Apart from the original game, DARQ: Complete Edition contains two DLCs, including The Crypt, which is available to play today for the first time. 

If you already own the original DARQ, you can download both DLCs, The Tower and The Crypt, for free.

While we know this news is not directly related to The Padre, we wanted to share it with you since we’re pretty sure that if you are interested in  The Padre, you’ll enjoy DARQ too!

Curious what awaits you in DARQ? Let us give you a little sneak peek:

DARQ will take you on a journey through a boy's dreams that quickly turn into a loop of nightmares. Lloyd, the main character, is trying to wake up, but unfortunately, each attempt sinks him deeper into his lucid subconscious-driven dreams. Lloyd has to adapt to the new world, re-learn gravity, and strain his mind and all of his senses in order to solve puzzles and sneak past the creatures guarding the shadowy corners of DARQ.

Sounds fascinating, doesn’t it?

DARQ: Complete Edition is available on the following platforms:

 PC
 Xbox One
 PlayStation 4


Owners of the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions will get a free upgrade to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S version when it will release in 2021. DARQ: Complete Edition will also be released on Nintendo Switch early next year.


Find out more and grab free digital gifts from DARQ here:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq

Join Lloyd and help him wake up.

notes.title: The highly anticipated moment has finally come – The Padre will be releasing April 18th!
notes.content:
Before we go into any details, we wanted to thank each and everyone who has supported the Padre in its Early Access period. You guys are the reason why we decided to develop games! 

Now let’s move to some details:

What has changed since the last Early Access update?
- New story elements and new scenes
- Extended end game
- New cut scenes
- Melee and ranged combat reformed. It is much more convenient and straightforward now.
- New inventory and UI
- New music, voices, and voiceover elements
- Controller support redesigned
- Improved AI

Important note: The changes were so extensive that the previous saved games will not be working in the new version. We could not keep the consistency with the previous version.
Please start the story from the beginning to see every little addition. Thanks for your patience!

With the final release we will be upping the price to 19,99 USD/EUR. Those of you who have the Early Access version bought fret not! You don’t need to pay a dime for this update. We strongly recommend though you run the game again and see how the story of our demon slaying Padre has been improved.

We hope the updated version will bring you hours of entertainment that will stay with you for a while. Please enjoy the game!
-	Shotgun With Glitters

notes.content:
ACHIEVEMENTS are finally here!

Of course several fixes and tweaks too :)

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
New features and fixes

 Language Support 

German
Italian
French
Russian
Spanish


Death/Sin - Resurrection/Redemption system
There was no penalty of your failures and sins. It has changed...

Enhanced Combat
Faster melee combat and stronger weapons, but the enemies also learned new tricks to surprise you.

New Weapons and Items
A crossbow and a rifle for the shooters, an old rusty machete for the slashers. You just have to find them.

New scenes and puzzles
Plenty of new areas and a new fullscreen puzzle also added.

New Cutscenes
When you enter a new area a quick flythrough camera helps you a bit

Smaller additions

New music tracks
New voice lines
Story changes and new elements
Puzzle hint system
An annoying but helpful companion on your journey

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you for all the feedback! 
We were (and still are) in joy with all the kind things you guys have said about our game thus far. Rest assured, we have paid close attention to your criticism and are focused on making The Padre better than ever.

Right off the bat however, we could not solve every issue, but we are determined to transform our "promising" game to a great one.

The Upcoming Changes and the Reasoning Them;

We added three new rooms to the story - just because ;)
Two new weapons will appear somewhere in the mansion: Based on user feedback
In-game cutscenes added - We would like to make the game more movie-like, and draw you into the story, this seems to be a great tool to do that.
Puzzle Hints: some of you had problems with our puzzles. We did not want to make them easier, but instead added hints to understand their mechanisms better.
Zombies are more unpredictable, fast and deadly in close combat - We want to move away from close combat and make it a last resort. To be honest, it was not fun. We would like you to have fun.
Some items were hidden but not intentionally. Now you can see them.

 
As stated earlier, we are updating the game constantly, but there are a lot of things to improve. This is our first update. There are many more still to come.

We are confident that the game will slowly grow longer and overall, more fun!

And lastly, we would like to hear your voice about the changes! That’s the easiest way for us to know if we’re going in the right direction!

Till next time,

The Padre Team
